question.problem:
Given that 

$$
[\begin{aligned}{y}_{1} \\ {y}_{2}\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}0 & 1 \\ -1 & 2\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} \\ {x}_{2}\end{aligned}],
$$

 express the quadratic form $Q(x)=2{x}_{1}^{2}+{x}_{1}{x}_{2}+2{x}_{2}^{2}$ in terms of the components of $y.$
question.worked_solution:
First, notice that 

$$
[\begin{aligned}{y}_{1} \\ {y}_{2}\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}0 & 1 \\ -1 & 2\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} \\ {x}_{2}\end{aligned}]
$$

 

gives the following expressions for ${y}_{1}$ and ${y}_{2}:$

$$
\begin{aligned}{y}_{1} & ={x}_{2} \\ {y}_{2} & =-{x}_{1}+2{x}_{2}\end{aligned}
$$

By solving the first equation for ${x}_{2}$ and substituting it into the first equation, we obtain the following expressions for ${x}_{1}$ and ${x}_{2}:$

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} & =2{y}_{1}-{y}_{2} \\ {x}_{2} & ={y}_{1}\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we substitute these into our quadratic form expression:

$$
\begin{aligned}Q(x) & =2{x}_{1}^{2}+{x}_{1}{x}_{2}+2{x}_{2}^{2} \\  & =2(2{y}_{1}-{y}_{2})^{2}+(2{y}_{1}-{y}_{2}){y}_{1}+2{y}_{1}^{2} \\  & =8{y}_{1}^{2}-8{y}_{1}{y}_{2}+2{y}_{2}^{2}+2{y}_{1}^{2}-{y}_{2}{y}_{1}+2{y}_{1}^{2} \\  & =12{y}_{1}^{2}-9{y}_{1}{y}_{2}+2{y}_{2}^{2}\end{aligned}
$$
